items.title: v1.2 feature set (LOCKED, 6 features)
items.detail: Phase A: Import/Export Config + Smart Suggestions. Phase B: Batch Unsubscribe Manager + Undo Classify/Deploy. Phase C: Email Analytics Dashboard + Scheduled Digest. Feature freeze active — no 7th feature; new ideas go to the v1.3+ parking lot (project_locked_scope.md).

items.title: Tester feedback cycle
items.detail: After v1.2 Gmail perfection, run the tester feedback loop and ship v1.2.x patches before any new platform work (sequencing LOCKED 2026-04-19).

items.title: Apps Script auto-deploy hardening
items.detail: /api/deploy/auto works but needs a saved apps_script_id + script.projects token and the Apps Script API enabled in the user's GCP project. Smooth the connect-and-deploy path so non-technical users never have to copy-paste code.

items.title: CASA security verification
items.detail: Cloud Application Security Assessment is the 6-14 week critical path for restricted Gmail scopes. Keep OAuth scopes and client IDs frozen (changing them voids CASA). Resubmit to Chrome Web Store + Edge Add-ons at the end of the window.

items.title: Store listing assets
items.detail: Finalize screenshots, localized store copy (__MSG_extName__/__MSG_extDescription__), and the privacy/permissions justification. CWS rejection (Red Potassium / sign-in not reproducible) was handled 2026-04-14 with GCP fixes.

items.title: Foundation stack (business/legal)
items.detail: Domain (quiddityinnovations.com) → LLC → EIN → ToS → D-U-N-S (paused at step 5, needs EIN+DBA) → Gumroad. Runs parallel to dev; unblocks ~60% of paid-tier work.

items.title: Provider abstraction (highest risk)
items.detail: Phase 1 of the Outlook plan: extract the Gmail-specific code into a provider module so the same tier engine drives both Gmail and Outlook. ~80% code reuse target.

items.title: Microsoft OAuth2 + Graph API
items.detail: Phase 2-3: MS OAuth2 with PKCE + Azure AD app registration, then core ops (folders/categories, rules, message moves) via Microsoft Graph. Folders replace labels; categories add color.

items.title: Classification & search port + UI
items.detail: Phase 4-6: port the rules/AI classifier and search to the Graph data model, then adapt the side-panel UI. Goal is feature parity with the Gmail side — no Outlook-only features in this cycle.

items.title: Three tiers: Free / Pro $39 / Premium $79
items.detail: Monetization v2 approved 2026-04-16. Free core stays free; Pro and Premium add power features. Gmail-anchored 30-day trial. Side panel for unlicensed users is visible-but-read-only with a CTA.

items.title: Licensing backend (Cloudflare Workers + KV)
items.detail: Serverless license validation on Cloudflare Workers + KV — keeps the extension itself backend-free while gating paid features. BYOK AI model: users bring their own keys, optionally used in tandem.

items.title: Payments via Gumroad
items.detail: Start on Gumroad; migrate to Paddle only past ~$5k/yr revenue (parking lot).

items.title: QI Brain integration
items.detail: Wire brain_log_session.py / brain_update_state.py into real qi.log_session() / qi.log_decision() / qi.update_project_state() calls so EasyFlow's state and decisions surface on the QI Hive dashboard. Hive reporting block already in .claude/CLAUDE.md.

items.title: CI test runner
items.detail: Wire regression_test.js / dry_run.js / v12_feature_test.js and tests/test_smoke.py into an automated runner (npm test / GitHub Actions). Currently all manual.

items.title: Backend API documentation
items.detail: Document the Tools/app.py endpoints (port 8550) — request/response shapes for /api/config, /api/tier*, /api/filters/*, /api/migrate/*, /api/deploy/auto — for future contributors and the Outlook port.

items.title: RTL edition
items.detail: Arabic/Hebrew/Farsi/Urdu bundled as a dedicated RTL release (dir='rtl', CSS logical properties, mirrored icons). Explicitly deferred 2026-04-14 to avoid RTL layout work in the current cycle.
